payload.name: Extract explicit future plans as distinct memories
payload.description: When constructing memories, if a speaker states a future plan or joke in one message, ensure it is extracted as a distinct candidate and not merged with unrelated earlier statements from other turns.
content: During extraction, if a message contains an explicit future intention, plan, or joke (e.g., 'Maybe I'll...', 'I might...'), extract it as its own candidate, preserving the specific activity and using memory_kind 'plan' for intentions or 'event' for jokes/hypotheticals.

Do not merge this statement with earlier unrelated reflections about the speaker's habits or thoughts; keep candidates scoped to the source message unless the content is explicitly connected by the speaker.
When in doubt, prefer a separate candidate over an incomplete merged one; a longer, accurate memory is better than a short one that omits a key claim.

solves: The failure occurred because the extraction candidate merged a speaker's explicit future plan (writing a screenplay) with unrelated earlier reflections, omitting the plan. The generalizable mechanism is that extraction can conflate content across turns and drop key stated intentions. This skill applies whenever a message contains an explicit future intention or hypothetical activity; it directs the agent to keep such statements as separate, faithful memory candidates.
